@{58d5920aacff4444923bdec0|full_name}: If they're too close, bubble disappears, avatar disappears WHILE in menus.  And if anything, have personal space be an option you can turn ON, rather than default already being on

Also... I kinda wish I could make myself disappear when people get too close (people trying to perv under my dress.... even though there's nothing to see)
This was submitted awhile back, but yes I do want to see this function.
Honestly, the "personal space" bubble effect should just be a automatic thing that turns on when you bring up menu instead of a toggle

Know what would be nice about the personal space thing?
If instead of entire models disappearing there would be an option for only polygons within the bubble to go away from site.

a quick way to solve this issue would be to build the menu in a inverted normal cube with a skybox cubemap behind it. That way it would pass through everything it came in contact with and allow the user looking at it to see through anything it intersects, including but not limited to walls and geometry and other users. The menu should be something nobody can interact with but you no matter what.
I guess this could be marked as completed now with the latest menu changes?

@{59ddd5b51665da05755bf356|full_name} A semi-recent change to VRChat made it so that the menu can no longer be obstructed. Do you consider that a fix for your suggestion, or are you specifically asking for personal space to be enabled?
@{5b2821f1443b6a55287c67ad|full_name}: Believe the op was asking for personal space to automatically toggle on when in menus, and toggle off again upon closing it. Or the equivalent functionality.
@{5b1632dbda49382d3a3cf921|full_name}: I mean.. it's basically the same end goal, no longer having your menu blocked by avatars
@{59aa7497081b2f33bf266786|full_name}: Yes, and I was reiterating such in a clear way for the mods/devs sake, but thank you for reminding everyone that we're all saying the same goddamn thing.
@{5b1632dbda49382d3a3cf921|full_name}: My goel is that players cant get up in my face. Access to my menu at all times is nice, but that doesnt stop fat garfields from blocking all of my vision.

This feature has been implimented now but in a different method: the menu at a higher render queue shows over everything

Please mark as complete
@{5a570cf1b301553d0104bddd|full_name}: no, I've seen some shaders render over  the menu still.

As mentioned, the menu render queue change addresses this problem. In addition, the menu selection can no longer be obstructed by other users.

We're aware that some shaders can render over the menu, which is a separate issue we're looking into.

details: Allow for an option to have personal space enabled only when using your menu.
title: Personal Space Modification
